title: ElecLoad: Adaptive Electricity Load Forecasting Guided by Multiple Events (abstract)
note: arXiv v1, 4 Nov 2026, cs.AI with cs.LG. A context-aware agent reads load history plus event text (notices, weather alerts, schedules), judges each event's relevance, timing and interactions, then forecasts the horizon whole or in segments that sub-agents draft and a main agent reviews. Claims best results in most scenarios; no numbers in the abstract. Links code at github.com/zhjai/ElecLoad.

title: ElecLoad full text: datasets, horizons, models
note: Hourly sets: GEFCom2014 (with constructed event effects), Nord, PJM (Data Miner 2 metered load; EIA-930 also listed), SPP, LCL, iFlex; out-of-domain AEMO and ERCOT. Horizons 24 h and 96 h only. Metrics WAPE and NRMSE. Backbone Qwen3.5-4B trained by SFT then RL with a DeepSeek teacher on four H100 GPUs. 14 baselines incl. Chronos-2, TimesFM-3, LightGBM, ARIMAX.

title: ElecLoad full text: headline results
note: Table 2: first in 13 and second in 6 of 22 metric comparisons. GEFCom2014 96 h: WAPE 6.68% vs 8.18% for MemCast, NRMSE 8.42% vs 10.35%. PJM 24 h WAPE/NRMSE: ElecLoad 3.13/3.86, TimesFM-3 3.43/4.23, Chronos-2 3.61/4.40, LightGBM 4.89/5.75, ARIMAX 7.01/8.07. PJM 96 h: ElecLoad 6.03/7.28, TimesFM-3 6.11/7.48, Chronos-2 6.90/8.33, LightGBM 7.07/8.15.

title: ElecLoad full text: test design, PJM cases, inputs
note: PJM train origins 2004-05 to 2022-12, test 2025-01-01 to 2026-07-18: 112 cases at 24 h, 28 at 96 h, picked for coverage of entities, quarters and event counts, not every day. PJM events are NWS alerts and PJM emergency notices as text. GEFCom2014 future temperatures are said to be forecasts known at the origin. Baselines use the same cases, each through its own input interface.

title: ElecLoad full text: appendix, paired differences, cost, gaps
note: Table 15: paired WAPE difference vs the direct-only variant is -1.14 points on GEFCom2014 (95% interval -1.31 to -0.98), -0.35 on PJM (-0.58 to -0.12), -0.97 on LCL (interval includes zero). Cost 18.7k tokens per GEFCom case, 15.3k for PJM. No seeds, pre-registration or weights release stated. ARIMAX and LightGBM inputs not stated. PJM event-case counts differ between Appendix A.5 and Table 9.

title: zhjai/ElecLoad repository
note: One commit, no licence shown. Ships the agent runtime, inference, metrics and training entry points. README: datasets, trained checkpoints and paper results are not bundled; the snapshot is not verified as the revision behind the paper's numbers. The demo uses synthetic inputs and scripted replies: it tests mechanics, not accuracy. RL rollout and checkpoint selection are not shipped.

title: Search: ElecLoad title (paper and repository only)
note: Search on the paper title returned the arXiv abstract, HTML and PDF pages and a GitHub repository under the same account (zhjai/ano-repo, not opened; looks like an anonymised copy of the code). No blog, model card or third-party write-up.

title: Search: ElecLoad weights on Hugging Face, replication or reproduction (none found)
note: Search found no ElecLoad-trained checkpoint on Hugging Face and no third-party rerun. Only the base Qwen3.5-4B model card appeared (not opened), which is not the trained agent. Reproducing would mean training from the code or obtaining the checkpoint from the authors.
